call_points.text: Overall QAAUM including alternate assets grew 42% YoY to ₹6,279 bn; MF QAAUM rose 6% to ₹4,277 bn.
Equity MF QAAUM rose 10% YoY to ₹1,987 bn; equity MF mix was 46.5%.
PMS/AIF QAAUM including the ESIC and EPFO mandate grew 5x YoY to ₹1,945 bn from ₹287 bn.
The ESIC/EPFO mandate QAAUM alone was ₹1,898 bn in Q1FY27.
Passive QAAUM was ₹400 bn, up 14% YoY.
Monthly SIP contribution was ₹10.85 bn for June 2026 with 4.03 mn contributing accounts.
Total equity rose to ₹43,776 mn at June 2026 from ₹40,416 mn at March 2026.
Board approved a final dividend of ₹25.50 per share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval.
Allotted 3,97,297 equity shares on ESOP exercise during the quarter.
Board approved a proposed dividend of ₹25.50 per share for FY26.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹458.23 Cr (+6.9% YoY), net profit ₹187.11 Cr (-18.0% YoY).
Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC released its Q4 FY26 investor presentation, reporting ₹458 Cr revenue and proposing a ₹25.50/share dividend.
Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Limited shared the earnings conference call audio for Q4-FY2026 on April 23, 2026, at 4:00 PM (IST) via its website.

Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Limited scheduled a conference call on October 21, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST to discuss unaudited Q2 & H1 FY27 results, led by Managing Director & CEO A Balasubramaniam and CFO Pradeep Sharma.
Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹483.81 Cr and net profit of ₹220.98 Cr.
Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC reported Q2FY27 revenue from operations of ₹483.8 Cr and net profit of ₹221 Cr.
Prateek Savla, ACS 29500, and Mahesh Savla signed the audio recording of the earnings conference call for Q2 FY27, available on the company’s website.
